title: PANDA prostate cancer segmentation: code, manifests and result files for "Prostate cancer segmentation in PANDA biopsy images by late fusion of three pyramid levels, with provider-specific and external evaluation"
description: Pipeline code, configurations, split and selection manifests, model checkpoint, training history, WSI probability caches (with the release panda-wsi-cache-complement-20261027), per-case result files, figure scripts with provenance logs, and the manuscript sources of the PLOS ONE submission. The PANDA, SICAPv2 and PRECISE images are not redistributed; they are available from their public releases under their own licenses. Licenses: the code is released under the MIT license; image files derived from PANDA (listed in DATA_LICENSES.md) are shared under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, as the PANDA license requires; files derived from SICAPv2 and PRECISE keep CC BY 4.0.
notes: Code: MIT. PANDA-derived image files: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see DATA_LICENSES.md).
